niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” CTV advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, markets and whether you need full-service brand strategy, programmatic buying, direct-sold premium placements, or performance/DR execution.

Quick guide + recommended partners by need

- Large-brand/full-funnel TV + CTV integration
  - GroupM (WPP: Mindshare, Wavemaker), Omnicom Media Group (OMD, PHD), Publicis Media (Starcom, Zenith), Dentsu, IPG — best if you need global scale, cross‑screen planning and TV/linear integration.

- Programmatic CTV expertise / trading
  - The Trade Desk (DSP used by many agencies), Amobee, Cadent — good if you want advanced programmatic targeting, audience data and custom bidding.

- CTV-focused planning & guaranteed inventory (TV + addressable)
  - Simulmedia, Tremor, VideoAmp — specialists in CTV/advanced TV planning and measurement; often strong for audience-based TV buys and direct deals with publishers.

- Performance / direct-response CTV
  - Tinuiti and a few performance media shops specialize in conversion-driven CTV campaigns and creative optimization.

- Premium direct-sold placements / platform-managed services
  - Roku Advertising, Hulu/Disney Ad Sales, Amazon Ads and Samsung Ads offer managed services for premium inventory (these are platform sellers rather than traditional agencies).

What matters when choosing an agency
- Clear goals: brand lift/awareness vs direct response; reach vs frequency.
- Inventory access: programmatic, PMP/private marketplace, direct deals with Roku/Hulu/Amazon/etc.
- Measurement & verification: third-party verification (DoubleVerify, IAS, Moat), brand-lift studies, cross-device attribution.
- Data & targeting: first‑party data onboarding, use of identity graphs, household-level targeting.
- Creative capabilities: CTV-friendly spots, dynamic creative optimization, companion assets.
- Transparency & fees: CPMs, platform fees, and supply path transparency.
- Reporting cadence and KPIs: viewability, completion rates, conversions, GRPs/ reach metrics.
- Case studies and references in your vertical.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 specific agencies best suited to your situation (I’ll need your budget, target countries/markets, industry, and campaign objective), or
- Draft an RFP template you can send to agencies to compare proposals.

Which would you prefer?
